primitives.formula: Minoshroom inherits BaseTFBoss, not Minotaur behavior; registerAttributes reuses Minotaur attributes: HP120, movement0.25, base ATTACK_DAMAGE2 (native attribute default), KR0.5. FinalizeSpawn invokes native Mob finalization, ordinary random armor population, then equips diamond_minotaur_axe and requests ordinary spawn enchantments. Diamond tier attack bonus3 + axe parameter6 supplies +9 MAINHAND attack; settled unenchanted total11. Equipment updates apply native attributes; the axe attack-speed modifier -3.2 does not set mob AI cadence. Armor is not guaranteed zero: native population probability0.15*specialDifficultyMultiplier and equipment/enchantment rolls remain. Minoshroom weapon enchantment chance0.25*specialMultiplier, armor0.5*specialMultiplier. Axe gold enchantability is22, inherited durability1561 for diamond; no boss attack helper invokes ItemStack.hurtEnemy/postHurtEnemy, so ordinary axe wear is not charged by these mob hits. Native Player use of the same axe retains ordinary wear. Mainhand drop chance0 affects loot only. Installed multiplayerFightAdjuster=NONE is reused; no HP difficulty phase/regen/berserk threshold exists in Minoshroom.; Priority3 native MeleeAttackGoal(speed1,false) uses live target, path or melee reach, native LOS and melee AABB. Requires every-tick update; attack counter decremented then tested, resets20 before dispatch, independent of hurt success. It calls Minoshroom.doHurtTarget, which REPLACES ordinary Mob.doHurtTarget with EntityUtil.properlyApplyCustomDamageSource using twilightforest:axing, direct=causing=Minoshroom. Effective attack attribute passes native EnchantmentHelper.modifyDamage before victim.hurt, but the helper supplies ATTACKER itself as the affected Entity argument instead of victim (unlike Mob.doHurtTarget); target-dependent enchantment evaluation therefore uses that wrong entity context. This is separate from the later knockback helper, which receives the victim. True enables enchantment-adjusted ATTACK_KNOCKBACK*0.5, attacker XZ velocity*0.6 when extra knockback>0, and native post-attack enchantments. Helper mistakenly calls setLastHurtMob(attacker itself), not victim; preserve this installed distinction. False suppresses those success callbacks; true need not mean HP loss. It is a vanilla-like extended melee package, not an invented ordinary mob_attack CUSTOM_DAMAGE. Axing is physical-tagged with normal armor/Resistance/protection/absorption/cooldown.; Registered ToolEvents.addExtraAxeChargingDamage listens to LivingIncomingDamageEvent: uncanceled, server target, DIRECT entity Living and sprinting, nonempty MAINHAND instanceof MinotaurAxeItem => current newDamage +7. No source-type or successful-hurt test. Native Player difficulty scaling happens before this incoming hook, so settled unenchanted charging hit is D(11)+7, not D(18); Normal18, Easy13.5, Hard23.5 before downstream mitigation. A zero Player request (including Peaceful scaling) returns before the incoming event and cannot gain the bonus. Enchantments/other hooks can change the input. The same hook works for native Player sprint attacks (player_attack source) and a Minotaur that actually spawned with gold_minotaur_axe; a plain golden axe fails the item predicate. It is not a charge-only tag, and it does not require CHARGING synced flag. Return-false shield/cooldown rejection can occur after the bonus event.; Victim Player native blocking remains its own subsystem. Exact244 Living shield processing follows incoming callbacks; nonprojectile direct Living source invokes Player.blockUsingShield, then attacker.canDisableShield. The default IItemExtension returns instanceof AxeItem, inherited unchanged by MinotaurAxeItem/KnightmetalAxeItem. Native Player.disableShield sets current use-item cooldown100, stops use, broadcasts30. This does not depend on the boss melee helper receiving true. Blocking requires native warmup>=5, source direction and no BYPASSES_SHIELD; shield durability request is native1+floor(blocked shield damage) when>=3, subject to ordinary durability/creative/enchantment handling. Twilight adds no extra Minoshroom shield-disable mechanic. Slam bypasses shield and does not enter that block callback. Knight Phantom shield defense has its own early return described separately.; No Minoshroom hurt/isInvulnerableTo override, no source-specific projectile/explosion immunity, shield phase, damage cap, special iframe or HP gate. Registered type is not fireproof and no fall-immunity tag includes Minoshroom; normal native damage, optional equipment, Resistance and hooks apply. Boss membership prevents natural freeze buildup/helper Frosted admission, not every externally delivered IS_FREEZING damage request. Home radius20 uses valid same-dimension strict block-position distanceSquared<400 for priority5 AttemptToGoHomeGoal(speed1.25); it is navigation, NOT Naga-style source/owner admission or invulnerability. Higher-priority combat may preempt home movement. Targeting: native nearest Player(false mustSee), retaliation; no bespoke in-home target gate. BaseTFBoss refuses mounts/portals and fluid pushing; water slowdown1; Base lavaHurt ignites5 seconds then requests ownerless minecraft:lava4; only true hurt calls killLavaAround. It scans bossBB.inflate9 in unit steps, replaces exact Blocks.LAVA with AIR, without mobGriefing/hardness/container checks. Rejected cooldown/invulnerability prevents cleanup; true with absorption may still clean. This is environmental recovery, not fire immunity. Base death removal at20, normal dead hurt rejection; no resurrection/regen. Peaceful restores spawner at loaded valid home then discards; no far-away despawn. Native boss spawner range9 and nearest PlayerY<spawnerY+4, nonPeaceful, finalize then assign home. Spawn eggs without home are a different setup. Synced charge flags/counters and goal state are not custom NBT-saved; native HP/equipment/home persist.

primitives.formula: MORTAR_SHOOTING progress0/10/20 creates three HydraMortars per state sequence. Owner=parent Hydra via ThrowableProjectile(owner). Entity hit server requires owner nonnull; if target another mortar, requires target.getOwner().is(owner), not different owner (ownerless target dereference has no null guard); reject target.is(owner) or own HydraPart while owner Hydra. Allowed entity hit detonates; disallowed hit has no discard. Ordinary block top hit sets vertical speed0 and onGround=true; other faces detonate then still set onGround. Mega detonates on any block. Ground tick calls immutable velocity.multiply(.9) but discards its result: no extra .9 damping is applied. No airborne lifetime fuse.; detonate FIRST calls native Level.explode(source=mortar,radius ordinary0.1 or mega4,fire=canEntityGrief(level,mortar),interaction=MOB); THEN loops entities in mortarBB.inflate(1) without owner exclusion or LOS. Finally discard regardless accepted HP damage. There is no separate on-collision18 hit before explosion:18 is the post-explosion nearby query, and ignores explosion exposure. Standard radius/exposure damage formula and separate knockback apply. The18 request is fire-tagged, NOT IS_EXPLOSION or IS_PROJECTILE and NOT armor bypass; Explosion Protection applies to preceding explosion, Fire Protection to the custom18, ordinary Protection/Resistance/absorption/cooldown remain. Explosion may consume cooldown before18, so never sum full damage automatically. A reflected mortar splash can attempt multiple Hydra parts and counters; closed parts round18/8 to2, open heads forward18, owner-distance<=sqrt600 and shared parent cooldown still apply.; Entity tag REDIRECTABLE_PROJECTILE includes HydraMortar. This normal reflection does NOT clear onGround, extend fuse, use speed1.5 or toggle mega. An incoming projectile using superclass Projectile.onHit can first redirect a tagged mortar to its owner. Separately, a genuine source reaching HydraMortar.hurt calls super.hurt but ignores that return: on server any nonnull causing entity shoots along its look at1.5/inaccuracy0.1, clears onGround, adds20 fuse; only Living causing entity replaces owner; returns true regardless amount.
